source_full: In the midst of all the noise and rejoicing Labakan slipped off with his little box under his arm. He went to the stables, saddled his old horse, Murva, And rode out of the gate towards ALEXANDRIA. Nothing but the ivory box with its diamond motto was left to show him that the last few weeks had not been a dream.
